name: Boltzmann Distribution and Maxwell-Boltzmann Statistics
equations: f(v) = 4\pi\left(\frac{m}{2\pi k_B T}\right)^{3/2} v^2 e^{-\frac{mv^2}{2k_B T}}
\langle E_k \rangle = \tfrac{1}{2} k_B T\quad (\text{per quadratic degree of freedom})
methods: Identify state energy E and thermal energy scale kT
Compute state occupation probability using Boltzmann factor exp(-E/kT)
Apply equipartition theorem to quadratic Hamiltonian modes
Integrate velocity distribution for average, RMS, and most probable speeds
problem_types: Atmospheric density profile under isothermal gravity (barometric formula)
Chemical reaction rate temperature dependence (Arrhenius law activation)
Thermal Doppler broadening of spectral emission lines
pitfalls: Applying equipartition theorem to quantum modes where hbar omega >> kT (frozen degrees of freedom)
Confusing most probable speed v_mp with root-mean-square speed v_rms
references: Reif Fundamentals of Statistical and Thermal Physics Ch.7
